summary: devprobe and loopprobe booted in turn, with two faults in the framebuffer's ioctl that devprobe's framebuffer rows must find

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 test-image build/tests/system/harness && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel tests/devprobe tests/loopprobe && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh image ${WORK} 2 tests/devprobe tests/loopprobe

status=0; for probe in devprobe loopprobe; do token=$(echo $probe | tr a-z A-Z); /bin/sh tests/proofs/guest.sh boot ${WORK} --net hubport,id=net0,hubid=0 --qemu-arg=-cpu --qemu-arg=max --append rach2.rescue --timeout 40 --steptmo 15 --ok "$token OK" --never "$token FAIL" "expect=Type 'help'" "send=exec /$probe" "expect=$token" 'expect=returning to kernel shell' || status=1; done; exit $status

faults.name: owner
faults.summary: the check that only the display's owner changes its mode taken out

lines: stale descriptor cannot release second owner's display
